name: playrunner
description: Build and run testing workflows on Playrunner Cloud or a configured self-hosted server.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Playrunner Cloud or your own Playrunner servers. Select configured servers during a chat without reinstalling the plugin. Cloud uses native OAuth; self-hosted servers use separate API tokens. Discover server capabilities, inspect workflows and execution results, author workflows and run tests. Browser authentication, environments and GitHub setup depend on server capabilities. Test completion is reported separately from passing test evidence.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Playrunner server and list its workflows.
Connect GitHub and configure an Authentication Profile for my tests.
Run my Playrunner workflow and explain any failures.
